en: Black‑and‑white industrial scene showing a large conical spoil tip or slag heap with a long conveyor running up its side, surrounded by factory buildings, smokestacks, smaller houses, and fenced fields in the foreground. The view is partly framed by a metal structure and gauge on the right, suggesting it is taken from within the industrial complex. The reverse side is a divided‑back postcard with Hungarian text identifying the publisher or photographer in Pécs.
